incident-bot: [PAGER] High error rate on /embeddings (us-west-2) — 5xx spike, paging alex (oncall). Auto-run: runbook/embeddings-timeouts. 

alex (oncall): saw the page, I'm on it. starting checklist now. can someone drop recent error samples?

sam (sre): past 10m we see 503 + upstream connection resets, 95th latency for tensor worker jumps to 1.8s. logs: `worker-42` OOM-ish messages around kv-cache flush. past deploy? not that I can see.

alex (oncall): grabbing a tail of api-prod logs, sending snippets.

alex (oncall): ```
2026-03-15T18:10:12Z ERROR embeddings-handler request_id=abc123 upstream=worker-42 status=503 msg="kv-cache eviction failure"
2026-03-15T18:10:12Z WARN  worker-42 free_mem=420MB
```

maria (support): customers pinging CS with timeouts — can we get a short customer-facing blurb? ideally one-liner + ETA.

jen (cs): drafting short + longer templates below. will finalize after we confirm mitigation.

alex (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) failover embedding route to us-east-1 standby pool (read-only for now), 2) scale up dedicated pool by +2 workers if capacity allows, 3) enable degraded-mode (shorter sequence length cap) to reduce memory pressure. going to try (1) first.

sam (sre): I can flip routing, but need approval to temporarily route ~20% of traffic to us-east-1 (cost/latency tradeoff). deploy-bot: any infra constraints for cross-region routing?

deploy-bot: Cross-region reroute toggle available. target route change queued — will apply once a human confirms.

rachel (pm): do it. better degraded latency than errors for customers. log a status page update.

alex (oncall): applying reroute now. posting check commands.

alex (oncall): ```bash
# verify health after reroute
curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference.com/embeddings/health -H "x-region: us-west-2" | jq .
# check metrics
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide
```

sam (sre): reroute applied, sending smoke checks. initial error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in 2m. good signal.

maria (support): drafting customer update now. jen, sharing your drafts for Zendesk/Intercom macros: which tone do we want? apologetic + action + ETA?

jen (cs): yes. short template for quick replies, and a detailed one for escalation threads. copying both here — feel free to use/edit.

jen (cs): "Short (intercom snippet):
Hi — thanks for the report. We’re seeing elevated timeouts for embeddings in us-west-2 and have rerouted traffic to a healthy standby region. You may see slightly higher latency; requests should succeed. We’ll update here when normal service is restored. — Jen, CS

jen (cs): Long (Zendesk macro):
Hi <Customer Name>,

Thanks for flagging this. Our engineering team has identified an elevated error rate impacting embeddings in the us-west-2 region. We’ve temporarily rerouted traffic to a standby region (us-east-1) to restore success rates while we apply a fix. You may notice higher latency for a short period. We expect full restoration within 30–45 minutes.

If you have a specific request or need an update sooner, reply here and we’ll prioritize. We apologize for the disruption. — Jen (Customer Success)

jen (cs): add note: for customers on Dedicated with regional pinning, include the dedicated-sales@ note and open a private incident with their account team.

alex (oncall): status page draft (short):
"We’re investigating increased errors for embeddings in us-west-2. Traffic has been rerouted to a standby region to reduce failed requests; some requests may be slower than usual. Engineers are working on a fix. Next update in 30 minutes."

rachel (pm): tweak: add affected services list to status page (Embeddings API, Batch-embeddings, Retries). Also include guidance for Dedicated customers.

alex (oncall): updating status page via ops console now. posted. incident-bot should pick it up.

incident-bot: Status page update (incident-1789004321): "Investigating: Increased error rates for Embeddings (us-west-2). Traffic rerouted to standby region."

sam (sre): follow-up actions: collect heap profiles from worker-42, check quantization change toggles, and ensure KV cache eviction logic has guard rails. I'll start heap dump on worker-42, may require brief restart.

alex (oncall): approve restart if necessary, prefer rolling restart to avoid global impact. also enabling degraded-mode config for embeddings to cap seq_len=1024.

sam (sre): heap dump started. rotating restart scheduled in 5m.

deploy-bot: Rolling restart initiated for deployment: embeddings-v3 (5 pods). Progress: 2/5 restarted.

maria (support): customer inbound triage checklist (macro) — please include in support playbook: 
- Confirm region and SDK version
- Ask for request_id if available
- Suggest retrying with smaller batch size / shorter inputs
- Offer to escalate to engineering (include link to private incident)

alex (oncall): adding a concise support macro below for agents to copy:

alex (oncall): "Agent macro: Embeddings timeouts — quick triage
1) Verify customer region: ask them to run `curl` with header `x-region` or check SDK config.
2) Request request_id from their last failed call.
3) Ask them to retry with batch=1 and seq_len <= 1024.
4) If on Dedicated and pinned to us-west-2, escalate to accounts team and note we applied a temporary reroute.

Template reply (short):
Thanks for reporting this. We’ve rerouted embeddings traffic to a standby region and reduced errors. If you’re still affected, please send the request_id and we’ll take a deeper look.

Template reply (technical):
We’ve observed kv-cache eviction pressure on workers in us-west-2 causing intermittent 503s. We’ve rerouted traffic and are performing rolling restarts and configuration tweaks (seq_len cap) to mitigate. If you can share the request_id, we can trace logs."

jen (cs): copying the macros into Zendesk as short + long templates now. tagging priority customers for manual outreach.

sam (sre): restart complete. metrics look stable; error rate at 1.5% and trending down. heap dump suggests a bursty KV eviction pattern during high-concurrency bursts. we’ll follow up with an engineering fix scheduled for next week.

alex (oncall): thanks team. timeline summary for handoff:
- 18:10 — pager triggered for embeddings 5xx spike (us-west-2)
- 18:12 — reroute to us-east-1 applied (error rate decreased)
- 18:18 — rolling restart completed; degraded-mode cap enabled
- 18:30 — error rate baseline ~1.5% and decreasing

alex (oncall): oncall handoff to evening shift: sam will continue monitoring, rachel will own the follow-up engineering ticket, jen/maria owning customer comms. leaving notes in the incident doc.

maria (support): leaving a short checklist for agents to use in case of repeat reports: 
- Use "Embeddings timeouts — quick triage" macro
- Escalate if request_id shows server-side 5xx in logs
- For Dedicated customers, open private incident and loop in account owner

alex (oncall): final: if anything spikes again ping @sam and @alex-oncall directly. closing pager for now but keep the incident thread open for updates.

incident-bot: Pager cleared by alex (oncall) at 2026-03-15T18:35:00Z.
